verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Zoho Books/Zoho MCP as exposing Zoho's own APIs as an MCP *server* so external LLM agents (Claude, GPT) can call Zoho's tools — the opposite direction of the story, which asks whether Zoho Books can itself plug in external MCP servers to consume their tools. No evidence shows Zoho Books acting as an MCP client or supporting arbitrary external tool servers.
